interventions.detail: Used Python 3.11 instead of README's Python 3.6
Used CPU torch 2.5.1/torchvision 0.20.1 instead of torch 0.3.1/torchvision 0.2.1; pinned numpy<2
Installed undocumented deps opencv-python-headless, matplotlib, scipy, pillow
Downloaded the Google Drive weights with gdown into weights/WIDERFace_DSFD_RES152.pth
Prefetched torchvision ImageNet resnet152 weights, which face_ssd.py downloads at model build time
layers/modules/__init__.py imports multibox_loss, which imports the nonexistent pa_sfd_match; removed that import
demo.py imports bbox_vote from widerface_val, whose module-level argparse/net.cuda()/dataset loading break the demo; inlined bbox_vote
demo.py: net.cuda() only if CUDA is available, torch.load map_location='cpu'
Detect old-style autograd.Function became a plain callable; replaced Variable(volatile=True) with torch.no_grad; fixed scores.dim() check to numel()
nms: replaced deprecated index_select(out=...) to avoid resize warnings
